subject: science
title: Parts of a plant and their jobs

cards.front: roots
cards.back: The part of a plant under the ground. Roots hold the plant in the soil and take in water.
cards.say: roots. The part of a plant under the ground. Roots hold the plant in the soil and take in water.

cards.front: stem
cards.back: The part that holds the plant up. It carries water from the roots to the leaves.
cards.say: stem. The part that holds the plant up. It carries water from the roots to the leaves.

cards.front: leaf
cards.back: The part that makes food for the plant using light, air and water. Most leaves are flat and green.
cards.say: leaf. The part that makes food for the plant using light, air and water. Most leaves are flat and green.

cards.front: flower
cards.back: The part of a plant that helps it make seeds.
cards.say: flower. The part of a plant that helps it make seeds.

cards.front: petal
cards.back: A coloured part of a flower. Bright petals attract insects.
cards.say: petal. A coloured part of a flower. Bright petals attract insects.

cards.front: fruit
cards.back: The part that grows from a flower and holds the seeds, such as a mango or a tomato.
cards.say: fruit. The part that grows from a flower and holds the seeds, such as a mango or a tomato.

cards.front: seed
cards.back: The part of a plant that can grow into a new plant.
cards.say: seed. The part of a plant that can grow into a new plant.

cards.front: Which part holds a plant firmly in the soil?
cards.back: The roots.
cards.say: Which part holds a plant firmly in the soil? The roots.

cards.front: Which part takes in water from the soil?
cards.back: The roots.
cards.say: Which part takes in water from the soil? The roots.

cards.front: Which part carries water up to the leaves?
cards.back: The stem.
cards.say: Which part carries water up to the leaves? The stem.

cards.front: Which part makes food for the plant?
cards.back: The leaves. They use light, air and water to make food.
cards.say: Which part makes food for the plant? The leaves. They use light, air and water to make food.

cards.front: Which part helps the plant make seeds?
cards.back: The flower.
cards.say: Which part helps the plant make seeds? The flower.

cards.front: Which part do we eat when we eat a carrot?
cards.back: The root. A carrot is a root that stores food for the plant.
cards.say: Which part do we eat when we eat a carrot? The root. A carrot is a root that stores food for the plant.

cards.front: Which part do we eat when we eat spinach?
cards.back: The leaves.
cards.say: Which part do we eat when we eat spinach? The leaves.

cards.front: Which part do we eat when we eat a mango?
cards.back: The fruit.
cards.say: Which part do we eat when we eat a mango? The fruit.

cards.front: Why do many flowers have bright petals?
cards.back: Bright petals attract insects such as bees. The insects help the flower make seeds.
cards.say: Why do many flowers have bright petals? Bright petals attract insects such as bees. The insects help the flower make seeds.

cards.front: Why do plants need roots?
cards.back: Roots hold the plant in place and take in water from the soil.
cards.say: Why do plants need roots? Roots hold the plant in place and take in water from the soil.

cards.front: What would happen if a plant had no leaves?
cards.back: It could not make its own food, so it would not grow well.
cards.say: What would happen if a plant had no leaves? It could not make its own food, so it would not grow well.

cards.front: Where do seeds usually form?
cards.back: Inside the fruit, which grows from the flower.
cards.say: Where do seeds usually form? Inside the fruit, which grows from the flower.

cards.front: Which parts of a plant grow up towards the light?
cards.back: The stem and leaves.
cards.say: Which parts of a plant grow up towards the light? The stem and leaves.

cards.front: Which part of a plant usually grows down into the soil?
cards.back: The roots.
cards.say: Which part of a plant usually grows down into the soil? The roots.

cards.front: Name the four main parts of a flowering plant.
cards.back: Roots, stem, leaves and flowers.
cards.say: Name the four main parts of a flowering plant. Roots, stem, leaves and flowers.

cards.front: True or false: The stem only holds the plant up and does nothing else.
cards.back: False. The stem also carries water from the roots to the leaves.
cards.say: True or false: The stem only holds the plant up and does nothing else. False. The stem also carries water from the roots to the leaves.
